_handoff.scopeNote: Official-source pass for the default Bengaluru building-plan path, with the smaller/Suvarna Paravanige lead used as the default scenario. Specific public BBMP/BPAS/GBA pages and documents were inspected without login, CAPTCHA completion, identifiers, file upload, payment, application submission, or case lookup.
_handoff.observationNote: The current BPAS FAQ and public portal expose an online, professional-led, single-window construction-permit route, current e-Khata messaging, document/NOC and payment guidance, risk-based timelines, public search controls, and a calculator. The Suvarna procedure PDF and the plan-sanction checklist provide specific scope and input leads. They do not establish eligibility, fee, inspection, or sanction for a particular property.
limitations: The current portal requires authenticated architect/applicant access for project creation, upload, payment, submission, status, and licence download; no credentials or bypass were used.

Several official documents are legacy or dated (including the 2020 Plan Approval Manual and older site-inspection procedure); their workflow text is retained as historical official guidance, not guaranteed current implementation.
The Suvarna PDF and checklist describe published service/input leads but do not decide whether an individual property qualifies or which current corporation/zone owns it.
No current public case-specific fee demand, inspection result, correction remark, approval/rejection, certificate, or licence was available without submitting property data.

meta.title: Bengaluru building plan approval official-source pass — IND-47
meta.disclaimer: Research handoff, not official advice or a building-permit application. Specific official sources and unresolved property-specific behavior are recorded together; do not submit personal data through this ledger.

sources.title: BPAS/GBA public construction-permit entry — Nambike Nakshe
sources.notes: Current public page observed 2026-08-31. It shows single-window construction permits, online digitally signed certificates, five city corporations, sign-in fields with CAPTCHA, public search/registration/payment links, and the message that e-Khata is mandatory for Building Licence, Plinth Certificate, and Occupancy Certificate applications from 1 July 2025. No login or value entry was attempted.

sources.title: BPAS/GBA building-permit FAQ
sources.notes: Current public FAQ observed 2026-08-31. It covers professional-led online filing, CAF fields, document/NOC leads, risk classification, eight construction-permit steps, payment mode, timelines, tracking, common rejection reasons, and single-window NOC handling. The FAQ contains older terminology and linked legacy references; claims are limited to what the page presently states.

sources.title: BPAS public downloads, manuals, forms and checklist directory
sources.notes: Current public downloads page observed 2026-08-31. It lists the Plan Approval manual, architect utility/help, Plan Sanction checklist, Schedule-II and Schedule-III, affidavits/bonds, Nambike Nakshe and Single Plot Approval forms, and zone GIS PDFs. Listing a file does not prove current eligibility or a completed application.

sources.title: Checklist for Building Plan Sanction
sources.notes: Direct public three-page checklist PDF observed 2026-08-31. It has fields for applicant/site, BDA layout, plot-area comparisons, RMP-2015 land use, conversion and revenue documents, Khata and tax receipt, earlier sanction, Metro NOC, NOC details, inspection date, road width, site/physical features, FAR/plinth/built-up area, floors/height, buffers, rainwater harvesting, solar, trees, solid waste, STP, transformer yard, and zoning-regulation comparison. It is a checklist example, not a property-specific determination.

sources.title: User Manual for Licensed Architect (Applicant) — BPAS Plan Approval
sources.publisher: Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike IT Department
sources.notes: Direct official PDF. Revision history ends at version 2.1 dated 27-08-2020. It documents authenticated architect registration, project creation, applicant/consultant details, document and geolocation tabs, application type selection, drawing upload/AutoDCR scrutiny, NOC and document attachment, site progress, challan, final submission, and proposal-flow checks. No authenticated action was performed.

sources.title: Suvarna Paravanige — Town Planning Section, Zonal Office
sources.notes: Direct official procedure PDF observed through the public BBMP document route. It describes residential sanction on a site area up to 4,000 sq ft, single BF+GF+3 upper floors, up to 4 dwelling units and height up to 15 m; names the zonal ADTP/designated office; lists online filing plus hard-copy records/drawings, 5% scrutiny/processing charge, inspection, document/drawing verification, demand note, fee receipt and approval/rejection; names form and document leads; and states 10 working days. The document does not resolve current property-specific eligibility or implementation.

sources.title: Procedure for Site Inspection — Building Plan Approval
sources.notes: Direct official site-inspection procedure PDF. The published table states inspection within 7 days of application for head-office plan sanction and within 3 days for zonal-office plan sanction, with publication of reports within 48 hours and 24 hours respectively; it also includes an inspection-report template. Search results identify the document as older guidance, so no current SLA is asserted.

sources.title: BBMP/GBA construction-permit fee calculator
sources.notes: Current public calculator observed 2026-08-31. It exposes service, use, built-up-area, building-type, dwelling-unit, locality and category controls and budget-head fields for scrutiny fee, ground rent, KTCP fee/betterment, security deposit, road cutting, labour cess, licence fee and related charges. Blank controls showed zero estimates; no property values were entered.

sources.title: BPAS Citizen Search
sources.notes: Public search surface observed 2026-08-31. Its visible fields/columns include project or proposal number, zone, ward, plot number, CTS number, applicant name, architect/L.E./S.E. name, and View Application. No search value or case was submitted.

sources.title: BPAS Building Licence Cell contact page
sources.notes: Current public contact page observed 2026-08-31. It lists the Additional Director and Joint Directors for the Building Licence Cell plus zonal Assistant Director contacts for South, East, Dasarahalli, Rajarajeshwari Nagara and Mahadevapura. It does not establish which officer owns a particular property or a response time.

claims.text: The public BPAS/GBA entry page describes a single-window clearance system for Greater Bengaluru Authority construction permits and says certificates are online digitally signed certificates.
claims.notes: Current public page observation; it does not prove that every permit category or certificate is available without an authenticated professional/applicant session.

claims.text: The public BPAS/GBA entry page exposes username, password and CAPTCHA sign-in fields for the permit system; this public-only pass stops before authenticated project creation or submission.
claims.notes: No credentials, CAPTCHA, or authentication attempt was made.

claims.text: The public BPAS/GBA entry page states that e-Khata is mandatory for Building Licence, Plinth Certificate and Occupancy Certificate applications from 1 July 2025.
claims.notes: Current portal message observed 2026-08-31. It does not show how e-Khata is validated or whether exceptions exist.

claims.text: The current BPAS FAQ says a building-permission applicant applies online with requisite documents and PreDCR drawings through empanelled professionals on the BBMP portal.
claims.notes: The FAQ states the professional-led route; no professional was selected and no application was created.

claims.text: The current BPAS FAQ says the architect fills a Common Application Form with plot and professional details including owner, plot size, colony category, zone and consultant details, and that relevant information is transferred to external agencies for NOCs as required.
claims.notes: This records the FAQ description, not the fields or NOC result for a particular case.

claims.text: The current BPAS FAQ lists plans and drawings, ownership documents, Khata extract/certificate, up-to-date tax receipt, and digitally signed professional/safety/supervision/debris-removal/indemnity declarations as CAF document leads.
claims.notes: The FAQ presents these as CAF document leads; exact requiredness remains proposal-specific.

claims.text: The current BPAS FAQ says NOC requirements depend on plot size, location, building type and height, and gives examples including aviation/fire/BESCOM for buildings at least 15 m, KSPCB/BWSSB for larger built-up area or 20-plus dwelling-unit residential proposals, SEIAA above 20,000 sq m, and BMRCL when a site abuts a proposed metro line.
claims.notes: The thresholds and agency examples are transcribed from the current FAQ; no property facts were supplied to select an NOC.

claims.text: The current BPAS FAQ says applicants do not need separate applications for listed inter-departmental NOCs because the single-window system transmits the relevant information to concerned agencies; it also says online communication is used for inspection scheduling.
claims.notes: The FAQ describes system routing; no NOC request or inspection event was initiated.

claims.text: The current BPAS FAQ lists eight construction-permit steps: online CAF, online sanction including required external NOCs, payment and release of the sanctioned plan, plinth-level commencement application, commencement certificate, occupancy CAF, BBMP/NOC-agency inspection, and applicable compounding-fee/charge intimation with occupancy-certificate release.
claims.notes: Published sequence includes later CC/OC stages; this pass concerns plan approval and did not proceed into a live case.

claims.text: The current BPAS FAQ says scrutiny fee is paid online with the application and other fees are paid against demand notes generated at plan-sanction, commencement-certificate and occupancy-certificate stages.
claims.notes: No amount, demand note or payment was generated for a case.

claims.text: The current BPAS FAQ says applicable charges are deposited through online modes such as RTGS, NEFT or net banking and that cash, cheque and demand draft are not accepted.
claims.notes: This current FAQ statement is recorded separately from older workflow documents that mention demand drafts; no payment method was tested.

claims.text: The current BPAS FAQ publishes risk categories B1 through B5 using plot size, height and floors for residential and non-residential buildings, and gives separate head-office and zonal-office working-day totals for plan sanction and later certificates.
claims.notes: The FAQ matrix is not used to classify an unknown property. The published totals range by risk and office; no sanction-time guarantee is inferred.

claims.text: The public Suvarna Paravanige procedure PDF describes zonal-office residential building-plan sanction for a site area up to 4,000 sq ft, up to four dwelling units and up to 15 m height, with online filing plus hard-copy records/drawings, scrutiny/processing charge, inspection, document/drawing verification, demand note, fee receipt and approval/rejection steps.
claims.notes: This is what the public procedure document states; it is not a property-specific eligibility decision and does not override current portal validation.

claims.text: The public Suvarna Paravanige procedure PDF lists latest Khata certificate/extract, latest tax receipt, sale/title deed, encumbrance certificate, conversion or land-use documents where applicable, revenue sketch where applicable, detailed building plan and architect licence copy as documents to enclose.
claims.notes: The document describes enclosure leads and uses 'wherever applicable'; no file was selected or uploaded.

claims.text: The public Suvarna Paravanige procedure PDF states a maximum service-delivery time of 10 working days.
claims.notes: Published document statement only; it does not establish a current case SLA or account for missing documents, inspection, risk category or portal changes.

claims.text: The public BPAS Plan Sanction checklist contains fields for applicant/site, BDA layout, plot-area comparisons, RMP-2015 land use, conversion and revenue records, Khata and tax receipt, prior sanction, Metro NOC, NOC details, inspection date, road width, site features, FAR/plinth/built-up area, floors/height, buffers and zoning-regulation comparisons.
claims.notes: Direct checklist observation; the PDF does not establish that every listed field applies to every proposal.

claims.text: The current BPAS downloads page publicly lists a Plan Approval manual, Plan Sanction checklist, Schedule-II prescribed application, Schedule-III supervision form, professional/owner affidavits, bonds and Nambike Nakshe/Single Plot Approval forms.
claims.notes: The page lists public downloads; individual form eligibility and current submission behavior remain unverified.

claims.text: The official BPAS Plan Approval Manual describes an authenticated architect workflow with project creation, applicant/consultant and plot/building details, document attachment, geolocation, application-type selection, drawing upload and AutoDCR scrutiny, NOC/document attachment, challan and final submission.
claims.notes: The manual revision history ends 27-08-2020. It is retained as dated official guidance, not proof of current authenticated UI or sequence.

claims.text: The official site-inspection procedure document states inspection schedules of within 7 days for head-office plan sanction and within 3 days for zonal-office plan sanction, with inspection-report publication within 48 hours and 24 hours respectively.
claims.notes: Older official procedure; no current inspection appointment or report was observed.

claims.text: The public BPAS fee calculator exposes service, use, built-up-area, building-type, dwelling-unit, locality and category inputs and budget-head estimates including scrutiny fee, ground rent, KTCP/betterment, security deposit, road-cutting, labour cess and licence fee.
claims.notes: Current blank calculator surface only; no amount is asserted for an individual proposal.

claims.text: The public BPAS Citizen Search surface exposes project/proposal number, zone, ward, plot, CTS, applicant, architect/L.E./S.E. and View Application fields/columns.
claims.notes: Public controls were observed without entering an identifier; no application result or licence was retrieved.

claims.text: The public BPAS contact page lists Building Licence Cell leadership and zonal Assistant Director contacts for South, East, Dasarahalli, Rajarajeshwari Nagara and Mahadevapura.
claims.notes: Contact listing only; it does not identify the correct authority for an unknown property or establish response time.

claims.text: No reviewed official public source establishes the correct route, current professional requirement, applicable document/NOC set, fee demand, scrutiny remark, inspection result, sanction decision or issued licence for a particular Bengaluru property without property and authenticated application data.
